In the aftermath of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''GR-75 medium transport''' supported the main [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] at the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] secret [[Haven|rendezvous point]] beyond the [[Galactic Rim/Legends|Galactic Rim]]. The [[Transport/Legends|transport]] was [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by a [[Unidentified Rebel commander (Haven)|Human male]] and participated in a [[Skirmish at Haven|skirmish]] after an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class cruiser]] happened upon the Alliance Fleet's position.
